answer: One concrete mechanism: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because summit only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, lagoon is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any zephyr approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
